key: FERN: Took you long enough.
en: FERN: Took you long enough.
ja: ファーン: 遅かったな。

key: Wouldn't have blamed you if this awful space sent you screaming though.
en: Wouldn't have blamed you if this awful space sent you screaming though.
ja: まあ、こんなひどい空間に叫んで逃げ出したって、責めやしないけどな。

key: I kept it here for you to take the first shot, just like I promised.
en: I kept it here for you to take the first shot, just like I promised.
ja: 約束通り、お前に先手をやるためにここに置いといてやったんだ。

key: But when you mess up, don't expect a second try!
en: But when you mess up, don't expect a second try!
ja: でも失敗したら、二回目のチャンスなんて期待するなよ!

key: Mew!
en: Mew!
ja: ミュウ!

key: MEW: Mew!
en: MEW: Mew!
ja: ミュウ: ミュウ!

key: FERN: What the hell?
en: FERN: What the hell?
ja: ファーン: なんだよ、それ?

key: It was just a transformed Mew?!
en: It was just a transformed Mew?!
ja: ただの変身したミュウだったのか!?

key: Uggggggggh.
en: Uggggggggh.
ja: うわああああ。

key: FERN: It looks like it hid somewhere in all that clutter...
en: FERN: It looks like it hid somewhere in all that clutter...
ja: ファーン: あのガラクタの山のどっかに隠れたみたいだな……

key: ...Knowing it, it probably just transformed into something else to hide.
en: ...Knowing it, it probably just transformed into something else to hide.
ja: ……あいつのことだから、また何かに変身して隠れたんだろうな。

key: First one to find it takes the next shot!
en: First one to find it takes the next shot!
ja: 先に見つけた方が、次の一手を取れるぞ!

key: No head starts-- I'm out!
en: No head starts-- I'm out!
ja: ハンデなしだ――行くぞ!

key: ...Just another plushie.
en: ...Just another plushie.
ja: ……ただのぬいぐるみか。

key: FERN: What in the fresh hell is all this?
en: FERN: What in the fresh hell is all this?
ja: ファーン: これ全体、一体何なんだよ?

key: A Mewtwo is here?
en: A Mewtwo is here?
ja: ミュウツーがここにいるのか?

key: Are you kidding me?
en: Are you kidding me?
ja: 冗談だろ?

key: This looks like a four year old threw up on one of those Blacephalon things.
en: This looks like a four year old threw up on one of those Blacephalon things.
ja: まるで4歳児がズガドーンの上に吐いたみたいな眺めだな。

key: And that's putting it politely.
en: And that's putting it politely.
ja: それでも、控えめに言ってるつもりだ。

key: Let's not dawdle longer than we have to.
en: Let's not dawdle longer than we have to.
ja: 必要以上にぐずぐずするのはよそう。

key: Mew hid somewhere again!
en: Mew hid somewhere again!
ja: ミュウがまたどこかに隠れた!

key: FERN: Tch.
en: FERN: Tch.
ja: ファーン: チッ。

key: So that's where it was...
en: So that's where it was...
ja: そこにいたのか……

key: But you let it get away again, huh?
en: But you let it get away again, huh?
ja: でも、また逃げられたわけか?

key: Fine, best two out of three!
en: Fine, best two out of three!
ja: よし、3本勝負で2勝先取だ!

key: Watch me be the one to find it this time!
en: Watch me be the one to find it this time!
ja: 今度こそオレが見つけてやるからな!

key: FERN: Caught you for real this time!
en: FERN: Caught you for real this time!
ja: ファーン: 今度こそ本当に捕まえたぞ!

key: UGGGGGGH, it's just another stupid stuffed Pokémon!
en: UGGGGGGH, it's just another stupid stuffed Pokémon!
ja: うわあああ、またただのバカみたいなぬいぐるみポケモンかよ!

key: I hate this place!
en: I hate this place!
ja: こんな場所、大嫌いだ!

key: FERN: I'm gonna find that stupid thing first!
en: FERN: I'm gonna find that stupid thing first!
ja: ファーン: あのバカな奴、絶対オレが先に見つけてやる!

key: No doubt about it.
en: No doubt about it.
ja: 間違いない。

key: So, I don't blame you if you wanna hightail it outta here and just let me have the win.
en: So, I don't blame you if you wanna hightail it outta here and just let me have the win.
ja: だから、お前がここから逃げ出してオレに勝ちを譲りたいって言うなら、それも責めやしないぜ。

key: If I were in your position and knew it was as hopeless as it is, I sure wouldn't wanna stick around this dump.
en: If I were in your position and knew it was as hopeless as it is, I sure wouldn't wanna stick around this dump.
ja: オレがお前の立場で、これがどうしようもないって分かってたら、こんなゴミために居座りたくなんかないからな。

key: I've just gotta figure out what that thing disguised itself as this time...
en: I've just gotta figure out what that thing disguised itself as this time...
ja: あとは、今度あいつが何に化けたか突き止めるだけだ……

key: FERN: If I were a Mew, where would I hide...
en: FERN: If I were a Mew, where would I hide...
ja: ファーン: オレがミュウなら、どこに隠れるか……

key: Perhaps the choicest location would be...
en: Perhaps the choicest location would be...
ja: 一番隠れやすい場所と言えば……

key: Hah! As if I'd say it aloud for you to copy from me.
en: Hah! As if I'd say it aloud for you to copy from me.
ja: はっ! 声に出して、お前に真似させてやるわけないだろ。

key: Nice try, \PN.
en: Nice try, \PN.
ja: いい手だったな、\PN。

key: FERN: ...All right...
en: FERN: ...All right...
ja: ファーン: ……よし……

key: Best three out of five!
en: Best three out of five!
ja: 5本勝負で3勝先取だ!

key: But now I'm gonna get serious!
en: But now I'm gonna get serious!
ja: でも、今度は本気出すからな!

key: You're about to not even stand a chance!
en: You're about to not even stand a chance!
ja: お前に勝ち目なんてなくなるぞ!

key: FERN: Considering its transformations so far, and triangulating each of its positions...
en: FERN: Considering its transformations so far, and triangulating each of its positions...
ja: ファーン: これまでの変身と、それぞれの位置を照らし合わせて考えると……

key: ...The most likely place to start looking will be in the...
en: ...The most likely place to start looking will be in the...
ja: ……一番怪しいのは……

key: Heh, I'm pinpointing it quick.
en: Heh, I'm pinpointing it quick.
ja: へっ、あっという間に絞り込んでやったぜ。

key: Better move fast if you want so much as a shot, \PN.
en: Better move fast if you want so much as a shot, \PN.
ja: チャンスが欲しいなら、さっさと動いた方がいいぞ、\PN。

key: FERN: ...
en: FERN: ...
ja: ファーン: ……

key: Four out of seven?
en: Four out of seven?
ja: 7本勝負で4勝先取か?
……いや

key: You and that Mew are conspiring together against me, aren't you?
en: You and that Mew are conspiring together against me, aren't you?
ja: お前とあのミュウ、オレに対してぐるになってるだろ?

key: That's the only logical conclusion.
en: That's the only logical conclusion.
ja: それしか筋の通る結論がない。

key: Cuz for as many times as you've found it, you still haven't caught it.
en: Cuz for as many times as you've found it, you still haven't caught it.
ja: だって、何度も見つけてるくせに、まだ一度も捕まえてないじゃないか。

key: I bet you're just waiting for the chance to sneak back up to where you fought it and make your escape together!
en: I bet you're just waiting for the chance to sneak back up to where you fought it and make your escape together!
ja: どうせ隙を見て、戦った場所までこっそり戻って、一緒に逃げるつもりなんだろ!

key: I'm onto your games!
en: I'm onto your games!
ja: お前の魂胆はお見通しだぞ!

key: You both want me to suffer, want to trap me in this puke-worthy para-spacial parade of pinkness, don't you?!
en: You both want me to suffer, want to trap me in this puke-worthy para-spacial parade of pinkness, don't you?!
ja: お前ら二人とも、オレを苦しめたくて、この吐き気がするようなピンク色の異次元パレードに閉じ込めたいんだろ!?

key: But it's not gonna happen!
en: But it's not gonna happen!
ja: でも、そうはさせないぞ!

key: I'll outwit the both of you and bring down your evil schemes despite everything!
en: I'll outwit the both of you and bring down your evil schemes despite everything!
ja: 何があろうと、お前らの裏をかいて、その悪だくみを打ち砕いてやる!

key: Because that's just who I am!
en: Because that's just who I am!
ja: それがオレって人間だからな!

key: Don't forget it!
en: Don't forget it!
ja: 忘れるなよ!

key: FERN: Don't even talk to me.
en: FERN: Don't even talk to me.
ja: ファーン: 話しかけるな。

key: Not until you're ready to stop playing mind games and just let me have the Mew properly.
en: Not until you're ready to stop playing mind games and just let me have the Mew properly.
ja: 心理戦なんてやめて、ちゃんとミュウをオレに渡す気になるまではな。

key: Mew flew into the portal!
en: Mew flew into the portal!
ja: ミュウがポータルの中へ飛んでいった!

key: LIN: WOW, this place is atrocious.
en: LIN: WOW, this place is atrocious.
ja: リン: うわあ、ここひどすぎ。

key: PLEASE tell me no one actually lives here.
en: PLEASE tell me no one actually lives here.
ja: ここ、まさか誰も住んでないよね、お願いだから言って。

key: this place needs an interior decorator, but i suspect that their eyes would jump out and run away at the sight of the place.
en: this place needs an interior decorator, but i suspect that their eyes would jump out and run away at the sight of the place.
ja: インテリアデザイナー呼んだ方がいいけど、多分ここ見た瞬間、目玉が飛び出して逃げてくと思う。

key: it looks like a trash can after a four year-old's birthday party,
en: it looks like a trash can after a four year-old's birthday party,
ja: 4歳児の誕生日パーティーの後のゴミ箱みたいだし、

key: vomit and everything.
en: vomit and everything.
ja: ゲロまでセットでね。

key: who the hell made this constellation of garbage??
en: who the hell made this constellation of garbage??
ja: このゴミの星座、一体誰が作ったわけ??

key: i mean, i guess it was me, but
en: i mean, i guess it was me, but
ja: まあ、あたしなんだろうけどさ

key: seriously, what the hell?
en: seriously, what the hell?
ja: マジで何なのこれ?

key: ANNA: I sure don't remember making this place, but boy am I glad I did!
en: ANNA: I sure don't remember making this place, but boy am I glad I did!
ja: アンナ: この場所を作った覚えは全然ないけど、作っといて本当によかった!

key: Hey, is there any more candy!?
en: Hey, is there any more candy!?
ja: ねえ、キャンディーってまだある!?

key: HEATHER: Plenty-- whee~ --in that chest.
en: HEATHER: Plenty-- whee~ --in that chest.
ja: ヘザー: いっぱいあるよ〜 わーい〜 その宝箱の中!

key: SHELLY: I think it might literally be bottomless?
en: SHELLY: I think it might literally be bottomless?
ja: シェリー: あれ、文字通り底なしなんじゃないかな?

key: NOEL: I'm getting a tummy ache from eating so much.
en: NOEL: I'm getting a tummy ache from eating so much.
ja: ノエル: 食べすぎて、お腹痛くなってきた。

key: LUMI: Here, my sister sent some extra water bottles with me. Want one?
en: LUMI: Here, my sister sent some extra water bottles with me. Want one?
ja: ルミ: はい、お姉ちゃんが余分に水のボトル持たせてくれたの。一本いる?

key: ANNA: This stuff is so good!
en: ANNA: This stuff is so good!
ja: アンナ: これ、すっごく美味しい!

key: Hey, do you think if we eat enough magical new world space candy, our insides will turn into a supernova!?
en: Hey, do you think if we eat enough magical new world space candy, our insides will turn into a supernova!?
ja: ねえ、このニューワールドの魔法の宇宙キャンディー、たくさん食べたら、あたしたちの中身が超新星になったりするのかな!?

key: LUMI: I don't think I have enough water to help THAT...
en: LUMI: I don't think I have enough water to help THAT...
ja: ルミ: それだと、水がいくらあっても足りない気がする……

key: ANNA: No, it's okay, because-- if a supernova is inside you, it doesn't hurt or anything!
en: ANNA: No, it's okay, because-- if a supernova is inside you, it doesn't hurt or anything!
ja: アンナ: ううん、大丈夫だよ、だって――お腹の中に超新星があっても、別に痛くないんだから!

key: It just makes your insides pretty and cosmic and maybe prevents kidney disease?
en: It just makes your insides pretty and cosmic and maybe prevents kidney disease?
ja: ただ中身がきれいで宇宙っぽくなって、腎臓病の予防にもなるかもだし?

key: Besides, don't they say that everyone is made from ancient stardust anyway?
en: Besides, don't they say that everyone is made from ancient stardust anyway?
ja: それに、みんな元々は大昔の星くずからできてるって言うでしょ?

key: SHELLY: Um, kind of!
en: SHELLY: Um, kind of!
ja: シェリー: えっと、まあそうだけど!

key: Like that's technically true, but that also means that everything else is made of stardust too.
en: Like that's technically true, but that also means that everything else is made of stardust too.
ja: それは厳密には正しいけど、それって他のものも全部星くずからできてるってことでもあるんだよね。

key: LUMI: Even gross things, like fungus and daytime television?
en: LUMI: Even gross things, like fungus and daytime television?
ja: ルミ: カビとか、昼間のテレビ番組みたいな気持ち悪いものも?

key: ANNA: "And you wouldn't BELIEVE who we have backstage right now--
en: ANNA: "And you wouldn't BELIEVE who we have backstage right now--
ja: アンナ: 「それで、今バックステージに誰が来てると思う――」

key: It's the red dwarf who walked out on you when you were a teenager!"
en: It's the red dwarf who walked out on you when you were a teenager!"
ja: 「あなたが10代の頃に出て行った、あの赤色わい星なんです!」

key: SHELLY: I think I remember that fairy tale a little differently...
en: SHELLY: I think I remember that fairy tale a little differently...
ja: シェリー: その昔話、あたしの記憶とはちょっと違う気がするけど……

key: HEATHER: Why do adults even-- whee~-- watch that stuff?
en: HEATHER: Why do adults even-- whee~-- watch that stuff?
ja: ヘザー: なんで大人って、わーい〜、あんなの見るの?

key: Like isn't there enough drama in their own lives all the time anyway?
en: Like isn't there enough drama in their own lives all the time anyway?
ja: だって、自分の人生だけでも十分ドラマチックなんじゃないの?

key: ANNA: I think it's like a distraction?
en: ANNA: I think it's like a distraction?
ja: アンナ: たぶん、気晴らしみたいなものなんじゃないかな?

key: Like it's easy to laugh when someone else gets hurt in a funny way, but nobody wants to slip on the banana peel themselves.
en: Like it's easy to laugh when someone else gets hurt in a funny way, but nobody wants to slip on the banana peel themselves.
ja: ほら、他の人が面白く痛い目に遭うのを笑うのは簡単だけど、自分がバナナの皮で滑るのは誰も嫌でしょ。

key: HEATHER: I guess.
en: HEATHER: I guess.
ja: ヘザー: まあ、そうかもね。

key: ANNA: Besides, adults aren't really as different from kids as people think.
en: ANNA: Besides, adults aren't really as different from kids as people think.
ja: アンナ: それに、大人って思われてるほど子供と変わらないと思うんだ。

key: Like, they're bigger,
en: Like, they're bigger,
ja: ほら、体が大きくなって、

key: And they've had more time to learn how to pretend to be bigger,
en: And they've had more time to learn how to pretend to be bigger,
ja: 「大きく見せる」やり方を学ぶ時間が長かっただけで、

key: But what's really different besides that?
en: But what's really different besides that?
ja: それ以外に、本当は何が違うんだろう?

key: NOEL: What others expect of them.
en: NOEL: What others expect of them.
ja: ノエル: 周りから期待されること、かな。

key: ANNA: Exactly!
en: ANNA: Exactly!
ja: アンナ: そう、それ!

key: I think we could solve a lot of problems if we gave adults the same kindness kids are shown.
en: I think we could solve a lot of problems if we gave adults the same kindness kids are shown.
ja: 大人にも、子供に向けるのと同じ優しさを向けてあげたら、色々な問題が解決すると思うんだ。

key: A few years here and there doesn't make that much difference, does it?
en: A few years here and there doesn't make that much difference, does it?
ja: 数年の違いなんて、そんなに大したことじゃないよね?

key: Everyone is always trying their best, and always making mistakes.
en: Everyone is always trying their best, and always making mistakes.
ja: みんな、いつも精一杯やってて、いつも失敗もしてる。

key: It may not undo the damage, but at least we know that our hearts are in the right place.
en: It may not undo the damage, but at least we know that our hearts are in the right place.
ja: それで傷が消えるわけじゃないけど、少なくとも気持ちだけは間違ってなかったって、分かってるから。

key: And we've already come so far as people!
en: And we've already come so far as people!
ja: それに、あたしたちはもう、人としてこんなに前に進んできたんだよ!

key: As long as we keep striving to improve as people, we'll eventually make it!
en: As long as we keep striving to improve as people, we'll eventually make it!
ja: 少しずつでも成長しようとし続ければ、いつかきっとたどり着けるよ!

key: NOEL: It's a shame that doesn't happen faster.
en: NOEL: It's a shame that doesn't happen faster.
ja: ノエル: それがもっと早く進めばいいのにね。

key: ANNA: Yeah, I know...
en: ANNA: Yeah, I know...
ja: アンナ: うん、分かってる……

key: That's why I'm staying here in the New World.
en: That's why I'm staying here in the New World.
ja: だから、あたしはこのニューワールドに残るの。

key: I've done enough.
en: I've done enough.
ja: あたしはもう十分やったから。

key: But I'm really happy that you all come to visit me so much~
en: But I'm really happy that you all come to visit me so much~
ja: でも、みんながこんなに会いに来てくれて、本当にうれしい〜

key: You'll come back again soon, right?
en: You'll come back again soon, right?
ja: また近いうちに来てくれるよね?

key: \PN opened the chest...
en: \PN opened the chest...
ja: \PNは宝箱を開けた……
